purpose: Document first-party discovery, current anonymous map/API route inspection, safe-field limits, and uncertainty.
assessment: The official Bangladesh DLRS/Settlement portal and official Belkuchi Upazila site were found in both English and Bengali discovery. The public map viewer is available anonymously and its current JavaScript was inspected. Administrative metadata reached Sirajganj and the BDS survey, but bounded upazila discovery returned an empty list, so no current Belkuchi parcel route, safe native identity, CRS, or geometry was verified. No GeoJSON sample is retained.
registryAssessment: DLRS/Settlement is evidenced as the national land-record and survey custodian, while the Belkuchi Upazila portal is a local administrative source. A city-specific open cadastral registry/map response was not established; registryFound remains null.
